import asyncio
from pathlib import Path
from piccolo.columns import BigInt, Integer
from piccolo.engine.sqlite import SQLiteEngine
from piccolo.table import Table

root = Path(__file__).parent
db_path = root / "test_db.sqlite"

if db_path.exists():
    db_path.unlink()

DB = SQLiteEngine(path=str(db_path))

class SomeTable(Table, db=DB):
    num1 = BigInt()
    num2 = Integer()

async def run_test():
    await SomeTable.create_table()
    guild_id = 625757527765811240
    guild = SomeTable(num1=guild_id, num2=guild_id)
    await guild.save()
    res = await SomeTable.select().first()
    await SomeTable.delete(force=True)
    
    assert res["num1"] == guild_id
    assert res["num2"] == guild_id

def test_bug():
    asyncio.run(run_test())
